spanish: Y traerás la minjá que será hecha desde estas a Jehová, y la acercará al sacerdote, y la acercará al altar.

findings.issue: Common noun H4503 is left as the untranslated lemma minjá; a common noun stays Spanish.
Distinct hiphil lemmas H7126 and H5066 are both rendered acercará, so any lexical difference is not visible.

notes: 2ms traerás, niphal será hecha, 3fs la, Jehová, sacerdote, and altar match the tokens.
